conditions.en: Create explicit word-addressed big-endian and default-byte-addressed little-endian maps with width four.
conditions.ja: 幅4で、明示word addressingのbig-endian mapと、既定byte addressingのlittle-endian mapを生成する。

expected.en: Names/parents are exact, bases are 256/512, widths are four and the configured endian values match.
expected.ja: 名前／parentは正確で、baseは256／512、幅は4、設定endian値が一致する。

limitations.en: Model-only tests use original eight-bit registers/memories and public map/block introspection, with fresh result queues and exact handle membership rather than iteration order. Explicit doors are set before observation; no unspecified initial door is inferred. Map removal uses disjoint maps in an unlocked model, avoiding shared-content ambiguities and queries through removed maps. Virtual registers are static overlays of their selected memories. Root/child isolation compares same leaf names with distinct handles. No bus, HDL or default-map behavior after unregister is asserted.
limitations.ja: modelだけの検査で独自8 bit register／memoryと公開map／block introspectionを使い、新queueと正確なhandle所属を確認し、列挙順に依存しない。doorは観測前に明示設定し、未指定の初期doorを推測しない。map解除はunlock状態のmodelの別map間で行い、内容共有の曖昧さや解除済みmap経由の照会を避ける。virtual registerは指定memory上のstatic overlayである。root／child分離は同じleaf名・異なるhandleを比較する。bus、HDL、unregister後のdefault map動作はassertしない。

expected_observations: UT: word parent 1 name words base 256 width 4 big_endian 1 unit 4

limitations.en: Original in-memory database/stream/recorder subclasses model callback outcomes; no files, vendor attributes, external database or HDL/DPI are involved. Preconstructed candidates expose whether initialization occurs after a null backend result. Explicit recording time 17 is metadata, not elapsed time. Queue contents are checked while the inconsistent unsigned count return is deliberately ignored. Link endpoints remain opened or closed-but-not-freed. Existing hook fixtures are linked with unchanged inputs; this supplies no new execution result or independent checks for every anchor.
limitations.ja: 独自のin-memory database／stream／recorder派生classでcallback結果をモデル化し、file、vendor attribute、外部database、HDL／DPIは使わない。事前生成candidateで、backend null結果の後に初期化されないことを観測する。明示recording time 17はmetadataで、経過時刻ではない。不整合のあるunsigned個数戻り値は無視し、queue内容を検査する。link endpointはopenまたはclose済みでfree前とする。既存hook検査は入力を変えず対応付け、追加実行結果や全anchorごとの独立した検査を与えない。

limitations.en: Finite inactive-parent child starts use explicit priority 25; no driver/arbitration ordering or global interleaving of hooks is prescribed. Optional hook counts are observed separately from exact parent callback arguments. Phase probes use concrete nodes from isolated schedules with no schedule execution or traffic; automatic objections are changed only between completed starts, never while a sequence is active. Query-locking behavior outside these execution boundaries is not inferred.
limitations.ja: 有限のinactive-parent child startで明示priority 25を使い、driver／arbitration順やhookのglobalな相互順序は指定しない。optional hook数を、正確なparent callback引数とは別に観測する。phase検査は独立scheduleの具象nodeを使い、schedule実行や転送は行わず、automatic objectionの変更は完了したstartの間だけで、sequence実行中には行わない。この実行境界外のquery lock動作は推測しない。

conditions.ja: local 3 fieldを使い、下位blockにもfieldを設定する。

expected.en: Exactly three local handles are returned with membership mask seven.
expected.ja: 正確なlocal 3 handleを、所属mask 7で返す。

limitations.en: Original locked three-level register-model fixtures have concrete eight-bit mapped registers and configured dynamic virtual registers/fields. Dynamic arrays need not be implemented for logical introspection. Fresh queues and exact set membership avoid order assumptions; name conflicts exist only between local and descendant scopes, with no ambiguous same-level match. Missing, ancestor and independent-root names are excluded. Map unregister uses a separate unlocked graph and observes only map content, not removed-model lifetime, block/default-map choices or a child map back-pointer. No bus or HDL behavior is asserted.
limitations.ja: 独自のlock済み3階層register modelで、具象8 bit mapped registerと、設定済みdynamic virtual register／fieldを使う。論理introspectionのためのdynamic array実装は不要である。新queueと正確な集合の所属を使って列挙順を仮定せず、名前競合はlocalと子孫の間だけで、同一階層の曖昧な一致はない。不在、ancestor、独立rootの名前を除外する。map unregisterは別のunlock済みgraphで行い、map内容だけを観測し、解除modelの寿命、block／default mapの選択、child mapのback pointerは対象外とする。busやHDL動作はassertしない。

conditions.en: Probe missing, ancestor root and peer root names.
conditions.ja: 不在名、ancestor root名、peer root名を照会する。

expected.en: All three results are null.
expected.ja: 3結果はすべてnullとなる。

limitations.en: Original locked three-level register-model fixtures have concrete eight-bit mapped registers and configured dynamic virtual registers/fields. Dynamic arrays need not be implemented for logical introspection. Fresh queues and exact set membership avoid order assumptions; name conflicts exist only between local and descendant scopes, with no ambiguous same-level match. Missing, ancestor and independent-root names are excluded. Map unregister uses a separate unlocked graph and observes only map content, not removed-model lifetime, block/default-map choices or a child map back-pointer. No bus or HDL behavior is asserted.
limitations.ja: 独自のlock済み3階層register modelで、具象8 bit mapped registerと、設定済みdynamic virtual register／fieldを使う。論理introspectionのためのdynamic array実装は不要である。新queueと正確な集合の所属を使って列挙順を仮定せず、名前競合はlocalと子孫の間だけで、同一階層の曖昧な一致はない。不在、ancestor、独立rootの名前を除外する。map unregisterは別のunlock済みgraphで行い、map内容だけを観測し、解除modelの寿命、block／default mapの選択、child mapのback pointerは対象外とする。busやHDL動作はassertしない。

statement.en: Map unregister disassociates its local register content.
statement.ja: map unregisterは、local register内容の関連付けを解除する。

conditions.en: Unregister an unlocked map with one local register.
conditions.ja: local register 1つを持つunlock mapを解除する。

expected.en: The map local register queue becomes empty.
expected.ja: mapのlocal register queueは空になる。
